QUOTE: The documented `.clew.yaml` sections map one-to-one onto the CLI options. Examples are `shared_key_patterns`, `thread_patterns`, `mqtt_dispatch`, `index_scope`, `doxyfile`, `kconfig`, and `preprocessor`.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says sections map one-to-one onto CLI options, but it never says the embedding caller's `options` names are the same words as the section names or that diagnostics use those words.
